title: 218. Open the Lock

examples.explanation: A sequence of valid moves would be "0000" -> "1000" -> "1100" -> "1200" -> "1201" -> "1202" -> "0202". Note that a sequence like "0000" -> "0001" -> "0002" -> "0102" -> "0202" would be invalid, because the wheels of the lock become stuck after the display becomes the dead end "0102".
We can turn the last wheel in reverse to move from "0000" -> "0009".
We cannot reach the target without getting stuck.
